options.summary: The Minimum plan keeps hire costs low but leaves heavy traffic delay and long queues.
pros: No tram or bus passengers blocked from service.
No pedestrians blocked and no vehicles fully blocked.
cons: Queue reaches 918 m with mean delay of 509 s per car.
risks: Some inputs are assumptions; read the numbers as ranges
Parameters are assumed, so real delay could differ.
Only 0.14 detour_share may overload the main route.

options.summary: The Standard plan matches the Minimum plan on traffic outcomes but costs much more in hire.
pros: No tram or bus passengers blocked from service.
No pedestrians blocked and no vehicles fully blocked.
Same traffic delay as the Minimum plan.
cons: Hire of 1765 AUD buys no delay reduction versus the Minimum plan.
Queue reaches 918 m with mean delay of 509 s per car.
risks: Some inputs are assumptions; read the numbers as ranges
Parameters are assumed, so the higher spend may not deliver expected outcomes.
Paying more without traffic benefit may be hard to justify.

options.summary: The Guided plan sharply cuts vehicle, queue and transit delay at the same hire cost as Standard.
pros: Delay drops to 937 vehicle-minutes and queue to 79 m.
Mean delay is 47 s per car.
Transit delay falls to 1651 passenger-minutes with nobody blocked.
cons: Hire is 1765 AUD, higher than the Minimum plan.
risks: 61% of drivers detour, so the detour itself may clog
Some inputs are assumptions; read the numbers as ranges
Parameters are assumed, so actual results may vary.
Sign-reading is a keyword-rule estimate and may not reflect real driver behaviour.
